author: emenblade
description: A self-destruct button that DMs you 6 hours later. Do not press.
install_msg: Load with `[p]load 321button`, then run `[p]321button setup` to configure (owner only).
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the timestamp of when a user pressed the button and whether they have been notified. Data can be deleted on request via `[p]mydata forgetme`.
